title: Junior Research Assistant (JRA)
salary_range: Rs. 25,000/- per month for the first two years and Rs. 28,000/- per month for the third year
summary: The University of Allahabad invites applications for the temporary post of Junior Research Assistant (JRA) under a UPCST sponsored research project in the Department of Chemistry. Eligible candidates with an M.Sc. in Chemistry and a domicile of Uttar Pradesh can apply by submitting their application via registered/speed post and email within 30 days of the advertisement.
eligibility_bullets: Must possess M.Sc. Chemistry (General Chemistry/ Applied Chemistry/ Industrial Chemistry) with 1st class in undergraduate and postgraduate examinations.
Candidate must be a citizen of India and a resident/domicile of Uttar Pradesh.
Maximum age limit is 28 years as on 1st April 2026, with age relaxation for SC/ST/PH as per GoI or CST-UP rules.
how_to_apply_steps: Download the application format attached to the official advertisement.
Fill in the complete biodata along with self-attested photocopies of mark sheets, certificates, and supportive documents.
Send the hard copy by registered or speed post to Dr. Varun Rai, PI, Department of Chemistry, Faculty of Science, University of Allahabad, Colonel Ganj, Prayagraj-211002, Uttar Pradesh.
Also, send a copy of the application as a single PDF file to the email address varunrai@allduniv.ac.in within 30 days of the advertisement.
